pages.title: THREE COMPANY RUMBLE Overview
pages.text:
■ A mini game in which you play Entertainment Coin Catch, the second round of the Coin Rush Showdown.
■ Your bunny girl Nikke automatically moves forward and attacks, but is defenseless against enemies closing in from behind and against attacks from a distance.
■ She will lose HP when she is attacked, and the game ends when her HP reaches 0.
■ Knock away other Bunny Girl Nikkes swarming in from both sides, collect coins, and survive as long as you can.

pages.title: Basic Controls & Gameplay
pages.text:
■ Tap (mobile) or press the space bar (PC) to change your character's direction. Changing directions makes your character briefly defenseless, which can be dangerous if an enemy is close behind.

■ Press the Ultimate Skill button (mobile) or press the Enter key (PC) to use an Ultimate Skill, which requires at least one Ultimate Skill stack.

pages.title: Items
pages.text:
■ Collect items that appear during the game to earn points or trigger special effects.

Coins: Grant you points. The amount of points granted depends on the coin's color.
Energy Drinks: Increase your Ultimate Skill stack by 1, up to a maximum of 2. Getting an energy drink while at maximum stacks will earn you bonus points instead.
Nets: Reduce the movement speed of enemy bunny girl Nikkes for a short time.
Golden Four-Leaf Clovers: Grant bonus points and increase all points gained for a short time.

help.title: Enemy Bunny Girl Nikkes and Hazards

pages.title: Enemy Bunny Girl Nikkes and Hazards
pages.text:
■ Certain bunny girl Nikkes from the different companies have their own special behavior patterns.
■ Learn each one's pattern to deal with them accordingly.

■ As the game progresses, hazards appear across the field.
■ Each hazard gives a brief warning before it appears, allowing you to prepare for it in advance.

pages.title: SPIN! and Combos
pages.text:
■ After defeating an enemy, turning the opposite direction and defeating another enemy will trigger the SPIN! effect.
■ A successful SPIN! earns bonus points.

■ Defeating enemies in succession within the time limit raises your combo.
■ Earning points while maintaining a high combo count grants additional points.

pages.title: Special Skills
pages.text:
■ Unlock Special Skills to gain additional effects that help with scoring.
■ Special Skills are unlocked by meeting specific conditions.
■ All unlocked Special Skills stack and apply at the same time.
